items.description:
As a platform operator, I want shared synchronization to process each enabled season independently, so that all competitions remain current without duplicated tenant-level provider calls.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  With three enabled seasons, GetFixtures, GetTeams, GetStages, GetTournamentGroups and GetStandings use the correct season identifier for each call.
2  If one season fails, retain its last successful data, record the failure and continue other seasons. Do not delete data because of a failure or incomplete response.
3  On job retry or concurrent instances, locking prevents overlapping logical work and upserts remain idempotent. Logs include SeasonId, Provider and CorrelationId.
4  When a season ends and is archived, stop recurring synchronization but retain its data. LiveScores remain shared; FixtureDetail is retrieved by external fixture identifier.

Required Changes  Update SportMonksOptions, IMatchDataProvider, SportMonksMatchDataProvider, MatchDataSyncJob and FixtureDetailSyncJob. Resolve livescore fixture IDs against the catalog before updating them.

Dependencies  BE01 and BE02.

As an end user, I want to select a competition and season with a clear default, so that I can follow the matches that interest me across several tournaments.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Bootstrap displays authorized competitions and seasons only, in the configured order. A single competition must not create a redundant All option.
2  Select the user's last valid context, then the tenant default. All is an explicit option and does not conflict with first-league defaults.
3  Changing competition updates fixtures and related details and cancels older requests. Store context in the URL without credentials.
4  On access changes or when no competitions are available, use a valid fallback context or a clear empty state rather than displaying unauthorized cached data.

Required Changes  Update wc-app competition and season selectors, route-query state and bootstrap models. Provide horizontally scrollable mobile tabs with keyboard support and RTL/LTR layouts.

Dependencies  BE05 and BE06.

items.description:
As a platform operator, I want to migrate existing fixtures to verified seasons while preserving predictions and points, so that multi-season operation does not lose or misclassify historical data.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Before enabling the expansion, match fixture IDs from seasons 26618 and 26998 against documented evidence. Do not default every row to LeagueId 732 or one SeasonId.
2  After backfill, every active fixture has a verified season. Quarantine unclassified rows and produce a remediation report; do not publish unclassified records.
3  Prediction, outcome, point-ledger and reward counts and relationships remain identical before and after migration. Migration performs no deletion or recalculation.
4  After Redis is flushed, visibility remains database- and tenant-setting based. A rollback test restores the previous scope without deleting new seasons.

Required Changes  Use a staged nullable migration, followed by backfill, constraints and indexes. Replace ActiveSeasonFixtureScope with CompetitionSeasonScope and remove cached fixture IDs as the authoritative visibility source.

Dependencies  BE01; complete before releasing new-season functionality.

items.description:
User Story — Submit Match Predictions from Mobile Application

Title

Submit Match Predictions for Available World Cup Matches

User Story

As a Registered Mobile User, I want to submit predictions for available World Cup matches, so that I can participate in prediction competitions and receive points based on prediction accuracy.

Description

The platform shall allow authenticated users to predict match outcomes using either:

  • Exact score prediction

  • Winning team prediction

When the user predicts match scores, the system shall automatically determine the predicted winning team based on the entered result.

Prediction rules, scoring policies, and point calculations shall be configurable from the Admin Portal.

The system shall automatically validate predictions against live match results and continuously update prediction statuses.

Acceptance Criteria :

Prediction Types

  1. The system shall allow registered users to submit predictions using:

    • Exact score prediction

    • Winner-only prediction

  2. Users shall be able to enter predicted goals for both competing teams.

  3. When score prediction is entered, the system shall automatically determine:

    • Winning team

    • Draw result if applicable

Prediction Validation

  1. The system shall allow predictions only for matches marked as available for prediction.

  2. The system shall prevent guest users from submitting predictions.

  3. The system shall automatically stop accepting predictions 5 minutes before match kickoff.

  4. The system shall validate duplicate prediction rules based on configured platform policies.

Prediction Management

  1. ​Prediction rules and scoring policies shall be configurable from the Admin Portal.

  2. Administrators shall be able to configure:

    • Prediction points

    • Winner prediction scoring

    • Exact score scoring

    • Bonus rules

    • Prediction availability rules

    • Re-submission permissions

  3. Predictions shall be isolated per tenant within the multi-tenant platform.

Automatic Result Processing

  1. The platform shall automatically calculate prediction results after match completion.

  2. The system shall compare predictions against actual match results.

  3. Prediction status shall automatically update to:

  • Correct

  • Incorrect

  • Pending

  • In Progress

  1. During live matches, the platform shall continuously synchronize match results and update prediction statuses automatically.

  2. Users shall be able to view:

  • Their submitted predictions

  • Prediction result status

  • Earned points

  • Match outcomes

Security & Performance

  1. Only authenticated users shall be allowed to submit predictions.

  2. The platform shall validate user authentication tokens before accepting predictions.

  3. Prediction APIs shall support high concurrent usage during major matches.

  4. The mobile package shall dynamically load tenant-specific prediction configurations and scoring rules.

items.description:
User Story — Prediction Leaderboard & Rankings

Title

View Prediction Leaderboard and User Rankings

User Story

As a User, I want to view the prediction leaderboard and rankings, so that I can track my position, compare my performance with other users, and increase engagement within the World Cup prediction platform.

Description :

The platform shall provide a dynamic leaderboard experience داخل تطبيق التوقعات لعرض ترتيب المستخدمين بناءً على:

  • إجمالي النقاط

  • دقة التوقعات

  • عدد التوقعات الصحيحة

  • ترتيب المستخدم ضمن التننت

The leaderboard shall support:

  • Global rankings

  • Tenant-specific rankings

  • Tournament rankings

  • Match day rankings

  • User profile ranking visibility controls

The feature should provide a modern sports-gamification experience similar to global prediction and fantasy sports applications.

Acceptance Criteria :

Leaderboard Display

  1. The platform shall provide leaderboard screens داخل تطبيق التوقعات.

  2. The leaderboard shall display:

    • User ranking

    • User display name

    • User avatar if available

    • Total points

    • Prediction accuracy

    • Number of correct predictions

    • Rank movement indicators

  3. The system shall support:

    • Global leaderboard

    • Tenant leaderboard

    • Tournament leaderboard

    • Weekly/daily leaderboard

Ranking Calculation

  1. The platform shall automatically calculate rankings based on configured scoring policies.

  2. Ranking calculations shall update automatically after:

    • Match completion

    • Prediction result validation

    • Point recalculation

  3. Rankings shall be isolated per tenant in the multi-tenant environment.

User Experience

  1. The mobile application shall support smooth loading and pagination for leaderboard data.

  2. Users shall be able to search or locate their ranking quickly.

  3. The system shall visually highlight the current logged-in user ranking.

Security & Privacy

  1. The platform shall support configurable visibility permissions for leaderboard data.

  2. Administrators shall be able to configure:

  • Public ranking visibility

  • Anonymous display modes

  • Tenant-specific visibility rules

  1. The platform shall prevent unauthorized access to private user ranking information.
